name: Wandering Towers

categories.label: Won (all potions full and all wizards in Ravenskeep)
categories.labelVi: Thắng (đầy bình thuốc và mọi pháp sư vào Ravenskeep)
categories.hint: Win needs both: every potion bottle full and every wizard in Ravenskeep

categories.label: Full potions remaining at finish
categories.labelVi: Số bình thuốc còn đầy khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Tiebreaker if several players finish in the same round

tiebreakers.description: If several players complete both goals in the same round, most full potions remaining wins
If still tied, victory is shared

winCondition: First player to fill all their potion bottles (by trapping wizards under towers) and move all their wizards into Ravenskeep wins; order of the two goals does not matter.

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player has all potions full and all wizards in Ravenskeep

notes: family: race-to-goal. No points. Tiebreaker taken from secondary sources; official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded to confirm exact wording (a wrong PDF was returned for the Arcane Wonders URL).
